title: Comparative genomics reveals the evolution of anthraquinone biosynthesis in Polygonaceae.
authors: Cheng, Qian; Meng, Fanbo; Yang, Xiuping; Song, Xiaoming; Chen, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过比较基因组和多组学分析研究蓼科蒽醌生物合成基因的进化与转录调控，虽涉及转录因子预测但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且方法以基因组学为主，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Polygonaceae is a globally distributed angiosperm family rich in anthraquinones (AQs), which contribute to diverse medicinal properties and species-specific chemical defenses. Despite their ecological and pharmacological significance, the evolutionary dynamics and transcriptional regulation of AQ biosynthesis genes in Polygonaceae remain largely unexplored. RESULTS: In this study, we combined comparative genomics and multi-omics analyses to investigate these processes. Phylogenomic reconstruction indicated that Polygonaceae diverged from its sister family approximately 66.26 million years ago. A total of 206 polyketide synthase (PKS) genes were identified, with lineage-specific tandem duplication driving substantial expansion. Polyketide biosynthetic gene clusters with dense PKS aggregation were detected in three species, primarily shaped by tandem duplication. By integrating gene expression and synteny analyses, candidate PKS genes likely involved in AQ biosynthesis were identified. Multi-level gene regulatory networks constructed from root transcriptomes of Fallopia multiflora across different growth years revealed hierarchical regulatory relationships and divergence among candidate PKS genes. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis further identified co-expression modules and transcription factors potentially associated with AQ biosynthesis, while machine learning approaches prioritized transcription factors regulating the glycosyltransferase involved in AQ modification. CONCLUSIONS: These results reveal the evolutionary expansion, diversification, and functional specialization of PKS genes, as well as the hierarchical transcriptional regulation underlying AQ biosynthesis in Polygonaceae. The identified candidate genes and regulatory networks provide a valuable resource for metabolic engineering and molecular breeding strategies aimed at enhancing medicinal AQ production.
abstract_zh: 背景：蓼科（Polygonaceae）是一种全球分布的被子植物科，富含蒽醌类化合物（AQs），这些化合物赋予其多样的药用特性和物种特异性化学防御功能。尽管具有生态和药理学意义，但蓼科中AQ生物合成基因的进化动态和转录调控仍 largely 未被探索。结果：在本研究中，我们结合比较基因组学和多组学分析来探究这些过程。系统发育基因组重建表明，蓼科约在6600万年前与其姊妹科分化。共鉴定出206个聚酮合酶（PKS）基因，其中谱系特异性串联重复驱动了显著扩张。在三个物种中检测到具有密集PKS聚集的聚酮生物合成基因簇，主要由串联重复塑造。通过整合基因表达和共线性分析，鉴定出可能参与AQ生物合成的候选PKS基因。基于何首乌（Fallopia multiflora）不同生长年份根转录组构建的多层级基因调控网络揭示了候选PKS基因间的层级调控关系和分化。加权基因共表达网络分析进一步鉴定了可能与AQ生物合成相关的共表达模块和转录因子，而机器学习方法则优先筛选出调控参与AQ修饰的糖基转移酶的转录因子。结论：这些结果揭示了PKS基因的进化扩张、多样化和功能特化，以及蓼科中AQ生物合成背后的层级转录调控。所鉴定的候选基因和调控网络为旨在提高药用AQ产量的代谢工程和分子育种策略提供了宝贵资源。
